_comment: Zevara Sunderscale STAYS at the gate (zevara_intro's own framing untouched)

entities.observe: A belt-slate at his hip, chalk stub worn to a nub, already a line into today's tally. Rust-brown scales, no plate for a desk posting — he'd rather be finishing the count than talking to you.
talk_pool: If you're here to report something, the slate's on the wall. Write it plain.
Quiet shift. Kit's counted, slates are current, and the cell's empty. Write that down as a good day.
Barracks business, filed here. Yours is filed at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: Sergeant Ashgrave
dialogue.text: Barracks is Watch business only. State yours.

entities._comment: she stays at the gate (zevara_intro unchanged)
entities.observe: Tidier than her schedule allows. A stack of gate-shift reports pinned under a paperweight shaped vaguely like a threat. She is almost never behind it. The gate keeps her busier than her own office does.
entities.toast: Watch Captain's desk. Empty, same as every other time you've walked past it.

entities.locked_toast: Barred, and empty behind the bars. You can tell by the quiet. Whatever ends up in here hasn't happened yet.
entities.observe: A single holding cell, iron-barred, straw swept into one corner. Duty-mundane, like everything else in this building — until it isn't.
A straw-packed target lashed to a post, set against the wall where a stray shot won't find a person. Scored through in a tight cluster, more or less -- somebody here takes the drills seriously.
entities.item_hint_toast: Nothing to shoot with. A bow in hand would do it.
entities.toast: You put an arrow in the straw. Not bad, for someone who still flinches at the draw.

entities.observe: A second kit crate, shoved into the corner and never reshelved. The sergeant's own tally probably missed it.
A folded half-letter, tucked behind a loose board. Someone started writing it and never finished.
A scrap of paper pinned low, tucked behind a loose board same as the letter across the room.
